description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, bringing long-term support, improved performance, and modern language features.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the JDK to version 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all dependencies and plugins are compatible with Java 25. Do not upgrade Spring Boot, Spring Framework, or migrate javax.* to jakarta.* as part of this task.
tasks.summary: Upgraded the matrix-agents-showcase project from Java 21 to Java 25. Updated pom.xml java.version from 21 to 25, and updated Dockerfile build and runtime stages to eclipse-temurin:25. Spring Boot 4.0.1 and all dependencies are compatible with Java 25. Build and all unit tests pass.
